definitions.explanation: A freestanding portable ladder that opens into an A-frame shape, used for reaching high places.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}に{乗|の}って{電球|でんきゅう}を{交換|こうかん}した。
examples.english: I stood on a stepladder to change the light bulb.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}を{広|ひろ}げて{設置|せっち}する。
examples.english: Open the stepladder and set it up.

examples.japanese: {脚立|きゃたつ}から{落|お}ちないように{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to fall off the stepladder.

notes:
{脚立|きゃたつ} refers to a stepladder, a self-supporting ladder that does not need to lean against a wall.

COMMON USES:
- {電球|でんきゅう}の{交換|こうかん} (changing light bulbs)
- {高|たか}い{棚|たな}へのアクセス (reaching high shelves)
- {掃除|そうじ} (cleaning high areas)
- {庭木|にわき}の{手入|てい}れ (garden tree maintenance)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {脚立|きゃたつ}を{広|ひろ}げる (open/unfold a stepladder)
- {脚立|きゃたつ}を{畳|たた}む (fold up a stepladder)
- {脚立|きゃたつ}に{乗|の}る (stand on a stepladder)
- {脚立|きゃたつ}から{降|お}りる (get down from a stepladder)

RELATED WORDS:
- {梯子|はしご}: ladder (general term, includes extension ladders)
- {踏|ふ}み{台|だい}: step stool
